_meta.purpose: Transparent heuristic cost estimates. These are NOT real-time prices. Every figure is a range, hand-calibrated against publicly advertised NZ rates during Phase 1, and is always surfaced to the user labelled as an estimate.
_meta.why_not_an_api: Commercial pricing APIs are either partner-gated (Booking.com) or prohibit caching and display outside their own maps (Google Places). A published rule table is auditable, reproducible, and free of licensing conflict — the project's assessment target is multi-agent orchestration, not price accuracy.

accommodation_per_night._note: Keyed by tier, then accommodation type. Hotels are further split by star rating where OSM tags one; hotel_default applies when stars are absent, which is the common case.

meals_per_person_per_day._note: Keyed by tier, then the user's budget_level. Covers three meals; budget assumes bakeries, food courts and self-catering, premium assumes a restaurant dinner.

attraction_entry._note: Keyed by the project's AttractionCategory. OSM carries no ticket prices, so these are category averages for NZ. Parks, viewpoints and beaches are genuinely free; the geothermal band is wide because it spans a free roadside hot spring and a full thermal park.

transport_per_day._note: Keyed by tier. Assumes a mix of local driving and short transfers within the destination; the low end reflects walking a compact centre, the high end a rental car with fuel and parking. Inter-city travel is out of scope (each plan covers one destination).

seasonal_multipliers._note: Applied to accommodation only. NZ summer is the peak; Queenstown-style ski demand is not modelled since the MVP destinations are not ski towns. Keyed by month number.
